What the brief says: Deposits are applied once, deducted only with approval and version, and disputable.
Assumption made (nothing structural was: "Deposit" means the booking advance (advance_paise). No separate security-deposit model exists, so none was invented. Deduction and dispute run through the retention-case workflow (retention.ts) behind retentionDisputesEnabled.
Effect if the assumption is wrong: If a separate security deposit is meant, a new requirement must be added to this register; the workflow may be reusable.

What the brief says: BOOK-006 hierarchical resource conflict; BOOK-007 multi-resource atomic allocation.
Assumption made (nothing structural was: The frozen build has no bookable resource tree. BOOK-006 is read as window / slot / owner-block containment; BOOK-007 as all-or-nothing across several slots or days. Nets and grounds are separate resources.
Effect if the assumption is wrong: If nets inside a ground must block the ground (or the reverse), that is a new requirement: not built.

What the brief says: Rescheduling must be atomic and follow the same rules as booking.
Assumption made (nothing structural was: Applies to confirmed, non-series bookings on the same ground. Customer cut-off equals the free-cancel window; customers may move twice; staff are not limited. A dearer slot raises the balance; a cheaper one than already paid is refused (RESCHEDULE_NEEDS_SETTLEMENT) rather than refunded automatically.
Effect if the assumption is wrong: Policy numbers would change; the mechanism would not.

What the brief says: Parity must be shown on desktop web, iPad web, iOS and Android.
Assumption made (nothing structural was: Only API-level parity can run here (four client identities). Device columns are NOT_RUN.
Effect if the assumption is wrong: Go-live gate stays closed until devices are run.

What the brief says: Test and live must be separated and fail closed.
Assumption made (nothing structural was: A live server will not start unless APP_ENV=live, real provider keys, FILE_SCANNER=clamav with a reachable ClamAV, and DEMO_MODE off. Operators must set these before the first start of the patched release.
Effect if the assumption is wrong: The server exits with a FATAL message instead of running unsafe.
